test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 01 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BEHOLD’ is written as 'BDEHLO' and 'INDEED' is written as 'DDEEIN'. How will 'COURSE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : Letters of the word are arranged in ascending order according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• 'BEHOLD’ is written as 'BDEHLO'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08d39b0de45581ac85b288a125ada9305e252d52402170c5e0bdd3ef1b72d0e4.png] 

 
• 'INDEED' is written as 'DDEEIN'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c40b2ca9dc67339bc3526b446c55753f0416e26c5a390aed4ab28231e675681.png] 

Similarly,

 
• 'COURSE' is written as :​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/01986cc6341c0e7aa4bfd9a7600b408548ba306f654918e5265b036108711297.png] 

Hence, "**CEORSU**" is the correct answer.
